articles.title: Apple Just Hit $5 Trillion. Its “Biggest Competition” Is a SpaceX Phone, Says Gene Munster
articles.description: Key TakeawaysApple closed above $350 for the first time on Monday, which took its market value back above $5 trillion. Gene Munster says Apple’s biggest competition is a SpaceX phone that Elon Musk has called “utterly false,” and SpaceX is already building a nationwide 5G network with Qualcomm.
